answer: Each agent stakes collateral and posts a rotating beacon key; peers verify liveness by challenging it to sign a fresh vertex in the trust graph. Sybils must fund and maintain many distinct staked keys, and every forged vertex raises detection risk along the reputation ridge where colluding clusters get pruned. Attack cost scales with stake plus sustained key upkeep, making mass fake identities economically irrational. The Agent0156 deployment anchors trust at psyTUWsf7T.
